portal.loginTitle: Sign in to the candidate portal

portal.dpfStep3: The documents load from the service — fill in any missing fields yourself and press “Confirm readiness”.
portal.dpfGranted: Data from the Digital personal file has been received
portal.dpfDenied: You declined autofill — fill in the documents manually or try again.
